text: 11月4日，商务部副部长凌激在上海主持召开进博会参展跨国企业圆桌会，鹏瑞利、欧姆龙、蔡司、赛诺菲、波音、福特等100余家跨国企业及外国商协会负责人参会。凌激表示，“十五五”时期中国将全面推进产业智能化绿色化融合化发展，人工智能赋能千行百业将催生巨大增量市场，将保障外资企业平等参与政府采购等合法权益，不断完善优化出口管制体系，营造市场化、法治化、国际化一流营商环境，希望跨国企业用好进博会等开放平台。与会企业表示，中国是企业全球市场不可或缺的组成部分，将坚定扩大在华投资，融入中国产业链供应链创新链。（商务部）
text_en: On November 4, Vice Minister of Commerce Ling Ji chaired a roundtable with multinational companies participating in the CIIE in Shanghai. More than 100 multinational companies and foreign business associations, including Perennial, Omron, Zeiss, Sanofi, Boeing and Ford, attended. Ling said that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, China will comprehensively advance the intelligent, green and integrated development of industries, and AI empowering all sectors will create a huge incremental market. China will guarantee the lawful rights of foreign-funded enterprises to participate equally in government procurement and will continuously improve and optimize the export control system to foster a market-oriented, law-based and internationalized first-class business environment. He expressed hope that multinational companies will make good use of open platforms such as the CIIE. Attending companies said China is an indispensable part of their global markets and that they will firmly expand investment in China and integrate into China's industrial, supply and innovation chains. (Ministry of Commerce)
